method: in a throwaway detached worktree of the commit (review m8); one mutation at a time; each anchor asserted to occur exactly once (LF text, written back with the file's own line endings); only the bound tests of the mutated side run (backend pytest with no cloud credential per PRB-002; frontend vitest, JSON reporter, --pool=threads); original bytes restored after each mutation, at exit and on a signal, and checked at the end
hash_basis: sha256 of the UTF-8 text with LF line endings
